paper.title_en: Generalized First Law and Smarr-type Relation: Beyond Additivity and Extensivity
paper.abstract_en: In this work, we develop a general framework for deriving the first law of black hole thermodynamics and the associated Smarr-type relation for 4-dimensional static spherically symmetric spacetimes within a broad class of generalized entropy models. In addition, by employing the entropy representation for the Reissner--Nordström (RN) black hole, we determine a concise curvature functional that depends only on this representation and its derivatives. A general flatness condition is derived, demonstrating that when the entropy Hessian metric is regular and nondegenerate, both homogeneous power-law transformations and a separate logarithmic branch leave the RN black hole's Ruppeiner geometry flat. On the other hand, Rényi, Sharma-Mittal, Kaniadakis, and LQG-inspired entropy deformations typically give rise to nonvanishing curvature in the regular thermodynamic regime, demonstrating that the extremality of the RN black hole does not by itself require a curvature divergence.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在广义熵模型框架下系统推导黑洞热力学第一定律与Smarr型关系，并利用熵表象分析RN黑洞Ruppeiner几何的曲率平坦条件，涉及Rényi、Sharma-Mittal、Kaniadakis和LQG启发熵等非加性/非广延修正，理论深度较高，与黑洞热力学主题高度契合。
decision.title_zh: 广义第一定律与Smarr型关系：超越可加性与广延性
decision.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们建立了一个通用框架，用于在一大类广义熵模型内，推导4维静态球对称时空的黑洞热力学第一定律及相关的Smarr型关系。此外，通过采用Reissner--Nordström（RN）黑洞的熵表象，我们确定了一个仅依赖于该表象及其导数的简洁曲率泛函。我们推导出一个一般平坦性条件，表明当熵Hessian度规正则且非退化时，齐次幂律变换和一个单独的对数分支都使RN黑洞的Ruppeiner几何保持平坦。另一方面，Rényi、Sharma-Mittal、Kaniadakis以及LQG启发的熵变形通常在正则热力学区域内产生非零曲率，这表明RN黑洞的极端性本身并不要求曲率发散。
